title: Non-analyticity of hairs of exponential maps
summary: Let $f_λ(z)=λe^z$, where $0<λ<1/e$. In 1984, Devaney and Krych showed that the Julia set consists of pairwise disjoint hairs. Viana further in 1988 proved that these hairs are $C^{\infty}$. In this paper we show that hairs are not analytic except for trivial ones. This solves a long-standing open question.
